item.title: Diane Kay Matthias
item.description: Diane Kay Matthias, 87, Columbia City, passed away at 6:05 a.m. on Thursday, Nov. 20, 2025, at Miller’s Oak Pointe. She was born on March 9, 1938, in Fort Wayne. Survivors include her children: Cynthia (Don Perrey) Lewis, Cody (Diane) Lewis, Julie, Carrie, Marti, and Tina; many step-grandchildren and great-grandchildren; sisters: Toni Smith and Linda...
